map.选择材料类型或直接输入氧指数 LOI 值，判定材料阻燃等级与燃烧性能分级。: Select a material type or enter the limiting oxygen index (LOI) directly to grade the material's flame retardancy and burning-performance classification.
map.氧指数 LOI（极限氧指数，%）为维持燃烧所需的最低氧浓度：LOI 不低于 27: The limiting oxygen index LOI (%, the minimum oxygen concentration to sustain burning): LOI not below 27 is a flame-retardant material (self-extinguishing away from the flame), 22 to 26 is combustible and below 22 is flammable; air contains about 21% oxygen, so a material with LOI not below 21 does not easily sustain burning away from the flame; per GB 8624 the burning performance of building materials is graded into A non-combustible, B1 flame-retardant, B2 combustible and B3 flammable, with LOI often used as a supporting criterion.
map.💡 氧指数 LOI = 维持蜡烛状燃烧所需最低氧浓度（%）；LOI 越高越难燃，: 💡 Limiting oxygen index LOI = the minimum oxygen concentration (%) to sustain candle-like burning; the higher the LOI the harder to burn, and air contains about 21% oxygen.
map.氧指数按 GB/T 2406 测定，空气中氧浓度约 21%，LOI≤21 的材料: The oxygen index is measured per GB/T 2406; air contains about 21% oxygen, so a material with LOI≤21 easily sustains burning in air.
map.GB 8624 燃烧性能分级：B1(难燃)对应 LOI≥32，B2(可燃)对应: GB 8624 burning-performance grading: B1 (flame-retardant) corresponds to LOI≥32 and B2 (combustible) to LOI≥26, for reference only.
map.同种材料因配方、厚度、添加剂不同，LOI 差异较大，应以实测值为准。: The same material can vary widely in LOI with formulation, thickness and additives; the measured value should prevail.
map.氧指数仅反映材料点燃难易，不直接等同于综合阻燃性能。: The oxygen index only reflects how easily a material ignites and is not directly equivalent to overall flame-retardant performance.
map.材料阻燃选型时按氧指数（LOI）判定在空气中是否可燃及阻燃等级。: In flame-retardant material selection, judge from the limiting oxygen index (LOI) whether the material burns in air and its flame-retardant grade.
map.对比不同材料 LOI，辅助选择符合 GB 8624 分级的制品。: Compare the LOI of different materials to help select products that meet GB 8624 grading.
map.教学演示「空气中难燃≠真空/高氧下不燃」的概念。: Teaching demonstrates the concept that 'hard to burn in air is not non-burning in vacuum/high oxygen'.
map.按默认参数（氧指数 LOI 45%）：空气中氧浓度约 21%，材料在空气中难燃，: With the default parameters (limiting oxygen index LOI 45%): air contains about 21% oxygen, so the material is hard to burn in air, rated 'extremely hard to burn', GB 8624 grade B1 (flame-retardant); assessed as 'almost non-combustible, requiring a high-oxygen environment to burn'. LOI>45 is usually classed as extremely hard to burn, LOI 21-27 as combustible and >27 as flame-retardant; the higher the value the better the flame retardancy.
map.氧指数高就一定安全吗？: Does a high oxygen index always mean safety?
map.LOI 反映材料在静态氧氮混合气中的着火下限，数值越高越难点燃；但真实火灾含热辐: LOI reflects the ignition lower limit of a material in a static oxygen-nitrogen mixture, and the higher the value the harder to ignite; but a real fire involves thermal radiation, convection and ignition-source intensity, so it must still be judged together with the total heat of combustion and actual conditions.
map.GB 8624 的 B1 是什么级别？: What level is B1 in GB 8624?
map.GB 8624 将建材燃烧性能分为 A（不燃）、B1（难燃）、B2（可燃）、B3: GB 8624 classifies the burning performance of building materials into A (non-combustible), B1 (flame-retardant), B2 (combustible) and B3 (flammable); the B1 flame-retardant level is the minimum compliance requirement for decoration and insulation materials in most public places.
